name: hcapp_processPayment
description: Records, confirms, or cancels a single payment for an event attendance (or membership/haberdashery when productType != 1). Uses a standard device-secret access token (@param = NULL — ValidateAppAuth uses the stored DeviceSecret as the token context). paymentType codes: 1=not paid (cancel existing), 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash (other amount), 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer (other amount), 8=credit (other amount), 100=confirm bank transfer (WankerBanker confirmation only). Creates HasherEventMap if none exists. Cancels any prior active payment before inserting a new one. On success, delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData or hcapp_syncUserData based on @appDomainType.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Compound access token. ValidateAppAuth is called with @param = DeviceSecret + HemId + '#' + INT(paymentAmount). Flutter generates with paramString: deviceSecret + hasherEventMapId + '#' + paymentAmount.toInt(). GUID_EMPTY is used as a placeholder when hasherEventMapId is unknown. The HC5 compound token also included userId and eventId; those components were dropped in HC6.

parameters.name: userIdWhoPaid
parameters.description: The hasher being paid for. Resolved from the HasherEventMap row if @hasherEventMapId is provided and this is NULL. Zero-UUID is normalised to NULL before token construction.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The event being paid for. Required when productType = 1; a param-validation error is returned otherwise. Zero-UUID is normalised to NULL before token construction.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapId
parameters.description: The specific HasherEventMap row. Resolved from userIdWhoPaid + eventId if NULL. If neither resolves an existing row, a new HEM is inserted. Zero-UUID is normalised to NULL before token construction.

parameters.name: paymentType
parameters.description: 1=not paid (cancel), 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash (other amount), 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer (other amount), 8=credit (other amount), 100=confirm bank transfer.

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: 1=event, 2=membership, 3=haberdashery. productType=2 records a credit-neutral membership payment (debit = fee) and advances HKM.MembershipExpirationDate per Kennel.MembershipRenewalMode (1=rolling +MembershipDurationInMonths from max(expiry, now); 2=fixed year (RECURRING annual window: only the month/day of Kennel.MembershipPeriodEndDate matter, its year is a sentinel; expiry = day after the NEXT occurrence of that month/day; refused errorType 2 only if the end month/day is unconfigured); 3=lifetime, expiry = sentinel 2999-12-31, refused if already lifetime). eventId is required (anchor). The HEM is anchor-only: no attendance/RSVP is set. The exists/cancel-existing logic is ProductType-scoped: each product keeps its own single-active-payment-per-HEM invariant. productType=3 (haberdashery, 1.2.0): debit = sale amount (@specialRunPrice override, else @paymentAmount); no event pricing/discounts/extras; HEM is anchor-only; MULTIPLE sales per HEM co-exist (no cancel-existing); paymentType=1 is refused (errorType 2) — individual sale cancellation is future work.

parameters.name: paymentAmount
parameters.description: Amount paid or owed. Required when paymentType < 100 (a param-validation error is returned if NULL or < 0). Cast to INT for token derivation — payments with fractional cents lose precision in the token.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(12,6) in SP; Payment.CreditAmount and DebitAmount are SMALLMONEY in the table. Intermediate SP variables are MONEY — project standard is DECIMAL(10,4) for monetary values.

parameters.name: minimumAttendenceValue
parameters.description: Minimum attendance state to set on the HEM row when paying. Negative values (sentinel -1) are normalised to NULL before use, which causes the AttendenceState CASE expression to compare against NULL and never raise the state — effectively a no-op minimum.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: paymentsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: kennelCreditsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: doPayForExtras
parameters.description: 0 = run fee only, 1 = include EventPriceForExtras in the debit. Defaults to 0 if NULL.

parameters.name: surcharge
parameters.description: Optional surcharge. Stored as COALESCE(surcharge, 0). Payment.Surcharge column is SMALLMONEY — implicit narrowing conversion on insert.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(10,4) in SP parameter; Payment.Surcharge is SMALLMONEY in the table.

parameters.name: paymentProvider
parameters.description: External payment provider name (e.g. 'Stripe').

parameters.name: appDomainType
parameters.description: Controls which sync SP is called after the write. 'AppDomainType.event' (default) → HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData; any other value → HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: paymentReference
parameters.description: Payment reference string. Auto-generated as 'HC:' + base-36 random if NULL. Uniqueness is enforced via a retry loop before insert.

parameters.name: transactionTimestamp
parameters.description: Client-supplied payment timestamp as a string. The SP casts LEFT(@transactionTimestamp, 23) AS DATETIME — truncates to 23 chars, loses any timezone offset, and implicitly widens to DATETIMEOFFSET on insert. An invalid date string will throw an unhandled exception before reaching the TRY block.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) in SP; Payment.PaidDate is DATETIMEOFFSET(7). The intermediate CAST is to DATETIME (not DATETIMEOFFSET), losing timezone.

parameters.name: specialRunPrice
parameters.description: Override price for this payment. Used as the debit amount instead of the calculated event price when set. If @useSpecialPriceAsDefault is non-zero, the derived discount is also persisted to HasherKennelMap. For productType=2 this overrides Kennel.MembershipPrice as the membership fee.

parameters.name: specialRunPriceReason
parameters.description: Free-text reason for the special price. Stored as COALESCE(specialRunPriceReason, ''). Also written to HasherKennelMap.DiscountDescription when @useSpecialPriceAsDefault is non-zero.

parameters.name: useSpecialPriceAsDefault
parameters.description: When non-zero and @specialRunPrice is set, the derived discount (originalEventPrice - specialRunPrice) is saved as a permanent discount on HasherKennelMap for this hasher at this kennel. Sentinel: NULL is treated as 0 (do not persist).

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Free-text note stored on the payment (haberdashery item description). Blank/whitespace stored as NULL. Added 1.2.0.

parameters.name: alsoPayRunFee
parameters.description: productType 2 only: 1 = also record the run fee at MEMBER pricing (zero price => FREE with 'member' Notes tag, other-amount methods map to base types, extras never included) and check the payer in (attendance floor minimumAttendenceValue, default 20) — atomically with the membership charge. Ignored (forced 0) for other product types. Added 1.4.0.

parameters.name: clientPaymentId
parameters.description: Idempotency key (1.5.0): the client generates the Payment row's id and retries the same request with the same id until acknowledged. If a Payment with this id already exists (any state, cancelled included) the call is a replay: success is returned with adHocData.alreadyProcessed = 1 and nothing is written. NULL (old clients) preserves server-side NEWID().

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success envelope. Always returned as rowset 0. On auth failure or param validation failure, this is followed immediately by rowset 1 (ErrorDetail) and the SP returns. On CATCH, this is also followed by ErrorDetail.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 on any failure.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1240 for param validation failures. 1940 for unhandled DB errors (CATCH).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 12 for param validation failures. 19 for CATCH failures. errorType from ValidateAppAuth for auth failures.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Present only on failure (after the Envelope rowset with success=0). Contains the HC.ErrorLog entry id and human-readable messages.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: ID of the inserted HC.ErrorLog row.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Same value as in the Envelope rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Same value as in the Envelope rowset.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short display title for the error.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: PaymentResult
rowsets.description: Present only on success (after the Envelope rowset with success=1). Single row summarising the processed payment. For paymentType=100 (confirm bank transfer), hasherWhoPaid, attendenceState, debitAmount, creditAmount, and creditAvailable are all NULL.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Identifies this as an ad-hoc result row to the client.

columns.name: hasherWhoPaid
columns.description: Display name of the payer, formatted per NameDisplayPreference. Falls back to HEM.DisplayName, then '<no name>'. NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: Attendance state after payment (after applying minimumAttendenceValue if higher). NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: Always 3 after any successful payment.

columns.name: paymentType
columns.description: The @paymentType value used.

columns.name: productType
columns.description: The @productType value used.

columns.name: debitAmount
columns.description: Amount owed after discounts (and special price if applied). NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: creditAmount
columns.description: Amount credited (0 for hash credit types 6 and 8). NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: paymentAmount
columns.description: The raw @paymentAmount parameter value as supplied by the caller.

columns.name: creditAvailable
columns.description: Kennel credit balance for the payer after the credit update. NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: paymentReference
columns.description: Generated or supplied payment reference code.

columns.name: discountAmount
columns.description: Discount amount applied (from HasherKennelMap or special price override). 0 for paymentType=100.

columns.name: discountPercent
columns.description: Discount percentage applied (from HasherKennelMap). 0 for paymentType=100.

columns.name: discountDescription
columns.description: Discount reason text (from HasherKennelMap or special price reason). Empty string for paymentType=100.

columns.name: newMembershipExpiry
columns.description: productType=2 only: the MembershipExpirationDate just written (2999-12-31 = lifetime). NULL for all other products and for paymentType=100. Additive in 1.1.0.

columns.name: runFeeAmount
columns.description: Combined membership+run only (alsoPayRunFee=1): the amount the run leg charged (0 when recorded as free). NULL otherwise. Additive, 1.4.0.

columns.name: runFeePaymentType
columns.description: Combined membership+run only: how the run leg was recorded (2=free member run, else the base method type). NULL otherwise. Additive, 1.4.0.

columns.name: alreadyProcessed
columns.description: 1 when this call was an idempotent replay of an already-recorded payment (nothing was written); 0 otherwise. Additive in 1.5.0.

rowsets.name: SyncRowsets
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the output of the delegated sync SP (HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData or HC6.hcapp_syncUserData), passed through verbatim. See the contract for the relevant sync SP for column definitions.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — if no existing HEM row exists for @userIdWhoPaid + @eventId when @hasherEventMapId is NULL
UPDATE HC.Payment SET IsCancelled=1, CancelledDate, CancelledBy_UserId — cancels any existing active payment for the HEM row before inserting a replacement (paymentType 2-8)
UPDATE HC.Payment SET IsCancelled=1, CancelledDate, CancelledBy_UserId — cancels active payment for paymentType=1 (mark not paid) if one exists
UPDATE HC.Payment SET ConfirmedDate, ConfirmedBy_UserId — for paymentType=100 (confirm bank transfer)
UPDATE HC.Event SET DoTrackHashCash=1 — on first payment (paymentType 2-8) if not already set
INSERT HC.Payment — inserts new payment row for paymentType 2-8
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET UserStartEvent, RsvpState=3, AttendenceState — updated after payment (paymentType 2-8)
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET DiscountAmount, DiscountPercent=0, DiscountDescription — when @useSpecialPriceAsDefault is non-zero and @specialRunPrice is set
EXEC HC.nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser — recalculates kennel credit balance for the payer
EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser — recalculates run totals for @userIdWhoPaid (skipped if NULL)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on param validation failures and CATCH

codeSmells.issue: @paymentAmount cast to INT in token derivation — truncates fractional cents
codeSmells.detail: The compound token suffix includes CAST(CAST(COALESCE(@paymentAmount, 0) AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(50)). A payment of $5.75 builds a token against $5. Any client that signs with the full decimal amount will fail authentication. This is inherited from HC5 and persists in HC6.

codeSmells.issue: @transactionTimestamp CAST to DATETIME outside TRY/CATCH — brittle, loses timezone
codeSmells.detail: Line ~362: COALESCE(CAST(LEFT(@transactionTimestamp, 23) AS DATETIME), GETDATE()). The CAST to DATETIME occurs inside BEGIN TRY, so it will roll back the transaction on an invalid date string. However, DATETIME does not carry timezone; Payment.PaidDate is DATETIMEOFFSET(7). The implicit widening from DATETIME to DATETIMEOFFSET on insert assumes UTC+0, silently losing the caller's timezone.

codeSmells.issue: Monetary intermediate variables are MONEY, not DECIMAL(10,4)
codeSmells.detail: @eventPrice, @creditAmount, @debitAmount, @originalEventPrice, @extrasPrice are declared as MONEY. Project standard for monetary values is DECIMAL(10,4). Payment.CreditAmount and Payment.DebitAmount are SMALLMONEY — narrowing implicit conversion on INSERT. Mixed money types increase the risk of rounding surprises in discount/percentage calculations.

codeSmells.issue: @surcharge type mismatch: DECIMAL(10,4) parameter vs SMALLMONEY column
codeSmells.detail: @surcharge is declared DECIMAL(10,4) and passed to the INSERT as COALESCE(@surcharge, 0), which writes to Payment.Surcharge (SMALLMONEY). Implicit narrowing conversion from DECIMAL(10,4) to SMALLMONEY. Unlikely to lose data in practice given typical surcharge sizes, but inconsistent with the table definition.

codeSmells.issue: minimumAttendenceValue sentinel -1 normalised to NULL causes silent no-op in AttendenceState CASE
codeSmells.detail: Line ~82: IF (@minimumAttendenceValue < 0) SET @minimumAttendenceValue = NULL. The subsequent UPDATE at line ~374 uses: CASE WHEN AttendenceState < @minimumAttendenceValue THEN @minimumAttendenceValue ELSE AttendenceState END. When @minimumAttendenceValue is NULL, the comparison is always NULL/unknown, so the ELSE branch always fires and the attendance state is never raised. This is correct behaviour for 'no minimum', but the use of -1 as a sentinel for NULL is an undocumented convention that could confuse callers.

codeSmells.issue: HEM INSERT for new attendee sets AttendenceState from @minimumAttendenceValue without applying NULL normalisation first
codeSmells.detail: Line ~219: the new HEM row is inserted with AttendenceState = COALESCE(@minimumAttendenceValue, 0) — COALESCE here correctly handles the NULL case. However, @minimumAttendenceValue has already been normalised to NULL if negative (line 82), so negative values passed by the caller always result in AttendenceState=0 for a newly created HEM. Callers expecting AttendenceState to reflect a negative sentinel will be surprised.

codeSmells.issue: Post-commit side effects run outside any transaction
codeSmells.detail: Lines ~399-404: EXEC HC.nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser and EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser are called after COMMIT TRANSACTION. A failure in either leaves the kennel credit or run counts stale — the payment itself is committed but the derived aggregates are not updated. This is a pre-existing HC5 pattern carried into HC6.

codeSmells.issue: Sync SP delegation also runs outside any transaction and re-uses the original accessToken
codeSmells.detail: Lines ~429-457: the delegated sync SP (hcapp_syncEventAdminData or hcapp_syncUserData) is called outside the transaction using the same @accessToken that was validated for the write operation. If the sync SP performs its own token validation with a different suffix expectation, auth will fail silently and the client will receive no sync data.

codeSmells.issue: paymentType=100 path commits inside BEGIN TRY but then falls through to the post-commit side effects via GOTO SyncAndReturn
codeSmells.detail: The paymentType=100 branch at line ~163 commits and emits its result rows, then executes GOTO SyncAndReturn (line ~191), which skips the post-commit credit/run-count updates but still calls the sync SP. This is intentional but subtle — the credit balance is not refreshed after a bank transfer confirmation, so the PaymentResult creditAvailable will be NULL (not stale, but callers may expect it to be populated).

Lifetime membership (MembershipRenewalMode=3) is represented as MembershipExpirationDate = 2999-12-31 rather than a flag column, so every existing 'expiry > GETDATE()' consumer works unchanged. Deliberate, documented sentinel (2026-08-08, docs/membership_payments_plan.md).

breakingChanges: TRY/CATCH and BEGIN TRANSACTION added — HC5 had no error handling or transaction. Error paths now roll back all writes atomically.

Success envelope rowset added as rowset 0 — HC5 returned PaymentResult directly as the first rowset. Callers must now read rowset 0 (success/errorCode/errorType) before consuming the PaymentResult at rowset 1.
ErrorDetail rowset introduced — HC5 had no structured error rowset. Failure paths now return two rowsets (Envelope + ErrorDetail).
Delegation targets updated to HC6 SPs — HC5 called HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData and HC5.hcapp_syncUserData; HC6 calls HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData and HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.
HC6 schema — all objects are in the HC6 schema; no HC5 schema objects are referenced.
behaviorNotes: 1.4.0 zero-price => FREE: for productType 1, paymentType 3/4/6 with computed run price (before extras) <= 0, the payment is recorded as PaymentType 2 with Notes 'member'/'non-member' (by the payer's membership status). Other-amount types 5/7/8 are never coerced. adHocData paymentType reflects the coerced value.
